messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling out v3.5.6 -> canary 4% in eu-west. Change window 15:00-16:30 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.example/releases/3.5.6 :rocket:
maya: quick FYI — this build flips tokenizer sharding; expect some warmup variance. please don't auto-advance.
ron: noted. watching p50/p95, traces, and tokenization errors.
ops-amber: seeing a tiny p95 bump (~+90ms) on two enc nodes after the shift, no 5xx increase. logs: `enc-1 WARN slowpath token_latency=310ms req=zyx`
seb: let's hold at 4% until we rule out cross-node shard imbalance. propose: pin canary, run a quick shard-check script, then reevaluate in 10m.
maya: agree. apply pin and abort auto-advance. if p95 >600ms sustained for 5m OR 5xx >0.5%, we'll rollback to v3.5.4. rollback cmd: `/deploy rollback --to v3.5.4 --scope canary`
deploy-bot: Canary pinned at 4%. Traffic advancement paused per request. Manual rollback enabled. Notifying oncall.
natalie-oncall: ack — monitoring dashboards and distributed traces. will report back at +5m with heatmap and top spans. :eyes:
